characterization_methods.key_findings: MatSAM accurately recognizes all phases (γ' phase, TCP phase and impurities); the binary key-structure mask retains only the thin elongated needle-like TCP phase (cell walls are not foreground).
characterization_methods.purpose: 识别并提取 NBS-3 显微图中的 TCP 相（细针状）等关键微观结构

inclusions: deeply dark in color and distinctly larger in area

precipitates.distribution: a few thin needle-/rod-shaped features within a coarser cell/dendrite-like dark network

structures.overall_structure: Coarser, cell/dendrite-like dark network with a few thin needle-/rod-shaped TCP-phase features; γ' phase present as small light grey areas and TCP phase as fine needle-like; impurities deeply dark in color and distinctly larger in area.

unmapped_findings: NBS-3 (TCP phase) 是用于验证 MatSAM 扩展性（extensibility/generalizability）的六个附加显微图之一；这些扩展实验图像样本未提供对应标注（annotations），因此论文未报告其定量分割性能（如 IoU/F1/Recall）。
